notes.drawing: A closed booklet with a globe emblem and one short line of lettering. The cover is the upright rounded rectangle Phosphor's file and book stand in (x 48 to 208, y 32 to 224, corner radius 8); no Phosphor icon is exactly that rectangle, so there is no frame check. The globe is Phosphor's globe at radius 52 (at 128,106) with its proportions: parallels a third of the radius above and below the centre, and a meridian lens from pole to pole, 0.37 of the radius wide on each side.
notes.bold: Only the cover and the line of lettering are bold (24). The globe keeps the regular stroke (16, a nested stroke-width the build keeps): at 24 its openings fill in, and every simplified bold globe read as an eye or a ball.
